'''Docking Bay 3-20A''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] facility on the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]]. The hangar was used to store a captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] prior to the destruction of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]''.
